hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the path of vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the street on both sides

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the narrow street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the midblock

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or physical barrier separating the roadway from the pedestrian area, creating a high risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire street frontage

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle ground of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, street side

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Numerous trash bags and a large trash bin completely block the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures the visibility of pedestrians, especially children, to oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or mid-block crossing points forces pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations without priority or visibility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible street segment.

hazards.name: Parked truck
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked at the curb blocks the view of the roadway for pedestrians and makes them less visible to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: A large tree and dense foliage near the curb line create blind spots for pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of image

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalk
hazards.description: No paved walkway exists, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire street edge visible in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks painted crosswalks, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the center background

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are uneven and cracked, creating potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the sidewalk width

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs

hazards.name: Tripping Hazard
hazards.description: Exposed and uplifted tree roots have severely damaged the sidewalk pavement.
hazards.location_in_image: At the base of the large tree

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Reallocate a portion of the roadway or parking lane to widen the sidewalks to a minimum of 6 feet of clear walking space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to reduce crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the narrow sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the curb line to physically prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Delineation
interventions.description: Clearly mark the pedestrian clear zone with paint or different paving materials to reinforce the intended use of the space.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian crossing warning signs to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, significantly reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access point to a standard driveway size and use different materials or raised elements to clearly define the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone with street trees to provide physical and psychological separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reinforce low speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the ends of the block to improve visibility for pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: Shared Street Treatment
interventions.description: If sidewalks cannot be added, implement traffic calming and signage to designate the area as a slow-speed shared space.

interventions.title: Construct Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a continuous, raised concrete sidewalk with a curb to provide a dedicated and protected space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Implement strict parking regulations and install bollards or planters to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate trip hazards and improve the overall walking environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to separate the walkway from the parking lane.

interventions.title: Waste Management Program
interventions.description: Implement designated trash collection areas or enclosures to keep the sidewalk clear of debris.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked surfaces and widen the sidewalk to meet ADA standards and accommodate pedestrian flow.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implementing speed cushions or humps would physically enforce low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune street-side trees and bushes to maintain clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Establish clear zones for trash collection to ensure the narrow sidewalks remain passable for all users, including those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds on this narrow residential corridor.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Program
interventions.description: Implement and enforce policies to keep sidewalks clear of trash and recycling bins to maintain a continuous walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Implement stricter enforcement or improved services for trash collection to ensure the pedestrian clear zone is not obstructed.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add more frequent pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and security during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and repair cracked concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Waste Management Policy
interventions.description: Implement or enforce rules for trash placement to ensure walkways remain clear for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement off-sidewalk trash storage solutions to maintain a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk sections to ensure a smooth, accessible surface.

interventions.title: Curb Extension
interventions.description: Construct a curb extension or 'bulb-out' around the tree to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant clear path for pedestrians without removing the tree.
